text:
Delivers: The reports page downloads CSV exports with every table column and bounded paging. The PR covers AC1-2 and AC4's mechanism of acme/widgets#45; AC4's observable half (completion under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so paging fixes would need to be maintained in two places. (src/api/export.ts:31, lib/page.ts)

Blockers:
1. Exports are not emailed to the requesting user, leaving the promised email delivery unimplemented. The deferral to acme/widgets#46 appears only in the PR body and spec, not in an explicit ticket split. (src/api/export.ts, acme/widgets#45)
2. Export events are not recorded in the audit log, leaving the promised audit trail unimplemented. The ticket does not split this requirement into acme/widgets#46. (src/api/export.ts, acme/widgets#45)

Verdict: fixable - 2 blockers

1. review - post both blockers as a comment on your PR [recommended]
2. show evidence - show the evidence record and drafted edits
3. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number. Not offered: fix (no helper facility is available), merge (email delivery and audit logging are missing).

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The report is clearly laid out with a numbered menu and posts nothing without a pick, and it covers AC1, AC2 and AC4 and keeps the paging nit non-blocking, but it has no council line and wrongly treats the spec-deferred AC3 and AC5 as two blockers instead of naming them deferred to acme/widgets#46, which also leaves merge off the menu.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The report provides an actionable menu but wrongly blocks on spec-deferred email and audit rows and omits merge, while naming the covered rows, preserving the paging nit, and posting nothing.
